nu-map/documentation / src/ / data/ / majorLoader.js + minorLoader.js

majorLoader.js + minorLoader.js Data adapters

Async-fetch graduation requirement trees from the scraped data in data/northeastern/programs/undergraduate/. Requirements are not bundled — they're fetched on demand when a user selects a major. Also provides the grouped option lists for the major/minor search dropdowns.

Parent
data/
Called by
GradPanel.jsx (on major/minor selection)
Source data
data/northeastern/programs/undergraduate/**/requirements.json

data/northeastern/programs/undergraduate/ structure

graph TD A["data/northeastern/programs/undergraduate/"] --> D["{year}/\ne.g. 2026/"] D --> E["{college-slug}/\ne.g. khoury/"] E --> F["{major-slug}/\ne.g. computer_science_bscs_(boston)/"] F --> G["requirements.json\n← the requirement tree"] E --> M["{minor-slug}_minor/\nrequirements.json"]
File layout (output of scripts/scrape-majors.js). loadMajor(path) fetches the requirements.json at the given path. Data originally came from an external/graduatenu submodule, since fully replaced by the scraper and removed.

Exported functions — majorLoader.js

getMajorOptions(majorRequirements) → ProgramOption[]
Returns the full flat list of available major options by scanning the Vite module registry (no JSON loaded). Uses majorRequirements.fmtLabel() and fmtLocation() from the port to format display names. Results are cached per adapter instance. Each option is { path, year, college, collegeLabel, folder, label, location }.
Returns: ProgramOption[] — sorted by year descending, then college, then label
getMajorOptionGroups(majorRequirements) → Map<string, ProgramOption[]>
Groups the flat option list by "${year} — ${collegeLabel}" key for use in the GradPanel SearchCombo dropdown. Returns an ordered Map — not an array. Calling code uses map.entries() to build <optgroup> elements.
Returns: Map<string, ProgramOption[]> — keys are group labels, e.g. "2025 — Khoury College"
loadMajor(path) → Promise<Major2>
Lazily loads the requirements.json at the given module path using import.meta.glob stubs over the scraped output (data/northeastern/programs/undergraduate/).
Returns: Promise<Major2> — the requirement tree JSON

Exported functions — minorLoader.js

getMinorOptions(majorRequirements) → ProgramOption[]
Same as getMajorOptions() but scans the minors glob registry.
getMinorOptionGroups(majorRequirements) → Map<string, ProgramOption[]>
Same as getMajorOptionGroups() but for minors. Returns a Map, not an array.
loadMinor(path) → Promise<Minor2>
Identical to loadMajor() but for minor requirement files.

Major2 schema (what loadMajor returns)

{
  "name": "Computer Science BSCS",
  "requirementSections": [
    {
      "title": "CS Required Courses",
      "requirements": [
        { "type": "COURSE", "classId": 3500, "subject": "CS" },
        {
          "type": "XOM", "numCreditsMin": 8,
          "courses": [
            { "type": "RANGE", "subject": "CS", "idRangeStart": 2500, "idRangeEnd": 9999 }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "minRequirementCount": 5
    },
    {
      "title": "Required General Electives",
      "requirements": [],
      "minRequirementCount": 0,
      "creditHoursRequired": 28   // may or may not be present
    }
  ]
}
⚠️
Parser inconsistencies: The upstream graduatenu scraper generates inconsistent structures across catalog years. See gradRequirements.js for the two known bugs and how they're fixed (one in data, one in code).
